[EN] Escort Services
[ES] Servicios de escolta
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'm sure the town and the peddlers would both be grateful.
[ES] Estoy seguro de que el pueblo y los mercaderes estarán muy agradecidos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Supplies bolster morale more than you know.
[ES] Los suministros mejoran la moral más de lo que imaginas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Begin your escort.
[ES] Comienza tu escolta.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thank you! I would have never made it without you.
[ES] ¡Gracias! Nunca lo habría logrado sin ti.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find the peddler along the eastern road and escort him to Crescentia.
[ES] Busca al mercader por el camino del este y escórtalo hasta Crescentia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Straight away."
[ES] "Inmediatamente."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Justarius at the entrance to Crescentia.
[ES] Habla con Justarius en la entrada de Crescentia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Honored to serve."
[ES] "Honrado de servir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Corann in Crescentia.
[ES] Preséntate ante Corann en Crescentia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
